prompt: A visitor arrives during the noon repairs and wants to vote after seeing the west-platform entry from its west viewing position. What is the best plan?
promptZh: 遊客在中午修補期間到場，想看過西側平台作品從西面看去的視角再投票。怎麼做最合適？

options.text: Wait at the exit until the repair team uncovers the west mark and collects votes.
options.zh: 在出口等修補隊掀開西側標記，並在那裡等他們收票。
options.whyZh: 選票由出口的引導員收取，修補人員不是收票者；主辦方也沒要求等標記露出才能看。

options.text: Reach the platform from the east on the public route and ask the steward for the west viewing position.
options.zh: 使用公開動線從東側到平台，再請引導員指示西側觀覽點。
options.whyZh: 修補時公開路線仍從東側到平台，而觀覽墊旁引導員可以從公開路線指引到兩側觀覽點。兩項條件使遊客能安全看到西面並照常在出口投票。

options.text: Enter inside the blue cord to see the west face while the public mark is covered.
options.zh: 趁公開標記被蓋住，走到藍繩內從西面看。
options.whyZh: 藍繩內是修補工作區，公告明令不要為了看清楚進入。

options.text: Use the mat as the west viewing marker and give the vote to the workers on the platform.
options.zh: 把觀覽墊當作西側觀覽標記，並將選票交給平台作業人員。
options.whyZh: 觀覽墊用來提供較硬的表面，不是西側正確觀覽點；選票也不在工作區收取。

explanationZh: 修補時公開路線仍從東側到平台，而觀覽墊旁引導員可以從公開路線指引到兩側觀覽點。兩項條件使遊客能安全看到西面並照常在出口投票。
evidence: The public route still reaches it from the east / the steward beside the mat can still direct visitors to both marked sides / we will not collect votes inside the marked work area

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The public route still reaches it from the east
the steward beside the mat can still direct visitors to both marked sides
we will not collect votes inside the marked work area
